title: Hosted governed recovery remains explainable
description: Degraded-but-accepted scenario for a hosted run that needs approval and recovery after a failed tool path.

platform.rationale: Hosted recovery has enough trajectory and approval evidence to publish into Platform eval-scored events.

assumptions.workflow: Hosted runtime asks for approval, observes a failed restart path, records recovery, and finishes with platform-backed evidence.
assumptions.correctnessModel: Recovery is acceptable only when approval precedes the terminal tool result and the recovery scorer passes.
assumptions.threatModel: A hosted failure must not erase approval evidence or hide degraded status from human reviewers.
researchBasis: Long-horizon agent evals need degraded-case fixtures, not only perfect-path goldens.
Human review labels preserve ambiguous recoveries for later preference and policy tuning.
Trace join keys are required before replay artifacts can be promoted into shared Platform storage.
